examples.japanese: {有給|ゆうきゅう}を{取|と}って{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I took paid leave and went on a trip.

examples.japanese: {有給|ゆうきゅう}が{残|のこ}っているか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked how much paid leave I have left.

examples.japanese: {有給|ゆうきゅう}{消化|しょうか}が{義務化|ぎむか}されている。
examples.english: Using paid leave has become mandatory.

notes:
{有給|ゆうきゅう} is short for {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか} (paid vacation/leave). It refers to paid time off from work.

Full form: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}

Common expressions:
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}を{取|と}る (take paid leave)
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}を{使|つか}う (use paid leave)
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}{消化|しょうか} (using up paid leave)
- {有給|ゆうきゅう}{残日数|ざんにっすう} (remaining paid leave days)

Cultural note:
Japanese workers often hesitate to use their paid leave due to workplace culture. Recent labor laws require companies to ensure employees take at least 5 days of paid leave annually.
